# EXTRAPAWN — Professional Chess Training Ecosystem

> EXTRAPAWN is a high-precision chess training and analytics platform built around structured 7-day and 30-day courses, Woodpecker repetition cycles, FIDE endgame simulators against our hybrid MOZERO neural network system, and deep Stockfish 19 + Coach positional explanations.

## Core Platform Sections

- [Welcome & Mode Overview](https://extrapawn.com/): Main entry point to the EXTRAPAWN chess training ecosystem.
- [Training Center (7/30-Day Courses)](https://extrapawn.com/training): Structured multi-day chess training courses across Tactics, Finish Him, Practical Chess, and Theoretical Endgames with Woodpecker error-correction loops.
- [Targeted WarmUp Arena](https://extrapawn.com/warmup): Customizable calibration sessions filtered by tactical motif, endgame piece configuration, or strategic theme.
- [Challenge Leaderboard & Records](https://extrapawn.com/challenge/records): Public competitive puzzle and endgame challenge records with machine-readable JSON export.
- [Challenge Records JSON Feed](https://extrapawn.com/challenge/records.json): Direct JSON endpoint for verified challenge records and leaderboards.
- [User Cabinet & Chess DNA Analytics](https://extrapawn.com/user-cabinet/mo3ep): Comprehensive Lichess player telemetry, Glicko-2 training progression, and endgame mastery heatmaps.
- [Club Top 20 & Tornado Analytics](https://extrapawn.com/club-player): Lichess team leaderboards and tournament performance tracking.
- [Pricing & Membership Tiers](https://extrapawn.com/pricing): Overview of Free, Club Member, and Pro training capabilities.
- [About EXTRAPAWN & Methodology](https://extrapawn.com/about): Detailed documentation of the MOZERO neural sparring system (LCZero + Elite-Leela-v2 + Syzygy/Gaviota), Glicko-2 rating engine, and training architecture.
- [Legal & Privacy Information](https://extrapawn.com/legal): Imprint, terms of service, and privacy policy.
